verdict.rationale: AvaTax explicitly supports assigning tax codes to line items and even offers AI-powered tax code recommendations based on product description/category/UPC, plus docs claim built-in handling of 'product taxability differences' across jurisdictions without custom rule engines — directly matching the story's need to categorize catalog items for correct per-jurisdiction taxation. Missing for 10: an explicit published taxonomy of category types (SaaS/digital goods/services/physical), a code sample showing the taxCode field in CreateTransaction payloads, and independent/hands-on corroboration of mapping accuracy.
